description: This file contains test common functions for GstWebAudioPlayer, including setup and teardown procedures, mock expectations for pipeline creation, element linking, and sink initialization, used in unit testing within a media playback project.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreatedForLlama
methods.description: Prepares expectations for creating a GstWebAudioPlayer for Llama platform, including source initialization, thread setup, pipeline creation, and sink addition.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreatedForXiOne
methods.description: Sets up expectations for creating a GstWebAudioPlayer for XiOne platform, similar to Llama but with different sink initialization.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeCreatedForGenericPlatform
methods.description: Configures expectations for creating a GstWebAudioPlayer for a generic platform, with auto sink addition.

methods.name: gstPlayerWillBeDestroyed
methods.description: Sets expectations for destroying the GstWebAudioPlayer, including thread reset, task stopping, and pipeline termination.

methods.name: expectResetWorkerThread
methods.description: Mocks the reset of the worker thread, including creation of shutdown task and thread join.

methods.name: expectTermPipeline
methods.description: Mocks the termination of the pipeline, including bus retrieval and unref operations.

methods.name: expectTaskStop
methods.description: Mocks the creation and execution of a stop task.

methods.name: executeTaskWhenEnqueued
methods.description: Mocks the enqueuing of a task to the worker thread, executing it immediately for testing.

methods.name: expectInitRialtoSrc
methods.description: Mocks the initialization of the Rialto source component.

methods.name: expectInitThreads
methods.description: Mocks the creation of worker and dispatcher threads.

methods.name: expectCreatePipeline
methods.description: Mocks the creation of the GStreamer pipeline.

methods.name: expectInitAppSrc
methods.description: Mocks the creation and configuration of the appsrc element.

methods.name: expectAddElementsAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Mocks the creation and initialization of the Amlhala sink element.

methods.name: expectAddElementsRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Mocks the creation and initialization of the RtkAudio sink element.

methods.name: expectAddElementsAutoAudioSink
methods.description: Mocks the creation and initialization of an auto-detected audio sink.

methods.name: expectMakeAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Mocks the process of creating the Amlhala sink element.

methods.name: expectInitAmlhalaSink
methods.description: Mocks the initialization of the Amlhala sink element.

methods.name: expectMakeRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Mocks the creation of the RtkAudio sink element.

methods.name: expectInitRtkAudioSink
methods.description: Mocks the initialization of the RtkAudio sink element.

methods.name: expectMakeAutoAudioSink
methods.description: Mocks the creation of an auto-detected audio sink.

methods.name: expectInitAutoAudioSink
methods.description: Mocks the initialization of the auto audio sink.

methods.name: expectLinkElements
methods.description: Mocks linking of pipeline elements including appsrc, convert, resample, and sink.

methods.name: expectAddBinFailure
methods.description: Mocks failure during adding a bin element to the pipeline.

methods.name: expectLinkElementFailure
methods.description: Mocks failure during linking of pipeline elements.
